blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The police force in Northern Mindanao has been placed on full alert on Monday for mass actions marking the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law. Maj. Joann Navarro, Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) spokesperson, told the Inquirer they have deployed units to key areas to ensure public safety and maintain a timely response capability during public assemblies. READ: PNP on alert as protests commemorate martial law To augment local units, PRO-10 placed 489 personnel — comprising 268 from the Reactionary Standby Support Forces (RSSF) and 221 from the Quick Reaction Forces (QRF) — on standby […]...
